name: website-qa-agent
description: An AI agent that tests websites in a real browser and reports bugs with screenshots.

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && cd backend && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.demo: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run demo --prefix backend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run test:e2e --prefix backend
